findings.description: Ísleifur Ísleifsson had a son Einar, christened 28 September 1856 at Kross, Rangárvallasýsla, Iceland.
supporting_sources: Iceland, Baptisms, 1730-1905 — entry for Einar, 1856, parents Isleifur Isleifsson and Thorun Einarsdr

findings.description: The mother named on the 1856 Einar baptism is Thórunn Einarsdóttir, not Guðríður Gunnlaugsdóttir, the wife the tree records.

person.name: Thórunn Einarsdóttir
person.role: named as mother on the 28 September 1856 Kross baptism
